description: Executable canonical contract for PythonIDE native iOS capabilities (v2). Single source of truth for Python modules, AppUI bridges, topic pages, navigation, runtimes, docs, Agent routing, scopes, risk, and user-action presentation.

device.description: Direct read-only device status facts exposed by the iOS runtime.

status.summary: Read battery, charging state, device model, and system version from the native runtime.

native_query.description: Read-only query bridge for current app/device/user-authorized local data.

start.description: Optional ISO-8601 or Unix start time.

end.description: Optional ISO-8601 or Unix end time.

include_samples.description: Include bounded sample records only when needed.

request_permission.description: Ask iOS for an undetermined permission and await the result. Defaults to true.

photos_count.summary: Count Photos library assets after Photos authorization is available.

photos_summary.summary: Summarize Photos library assets after Photos authorization is available.

contacts_count.summary: Count Contacts entries after Contacts authorization is available.

contacts_summary.summary: Return bounded Contacts samples after Contacts authorization is available.

calendar_events.summary: Read calendar events in a bounded date window after Calendar authorization is available.

reminders.summary: Read reminders after Reminders authorization is available.

location.summary: Read the current location after Location authorization is available.

device_status.summary: Read local battery and device status facts.

app_info.summary: Read local app bundle, locale, timezone, and device facts.

clipboard_text.summary: Read bounded text from the general pasteboard.

notification_settings.summary: Read current local notification authorization and delivery settings.

native.description: User-visible native mutation/export bridge for Photos, Calendar, and share sheet actions.

text.description: Text to write to the clipboard.

identifier.description: Stable notification identifier. Reusing it updates the same notification.

idempotency_key.description: Stable caller key that prevents duplicate notification creation.

request_permission.description: Ask iOS for an undetermined permission and await the result. Defaults to true.

start.description: Calendar start as ISO-8601 or Unix seconds.

end.description: Calendar end as ISO-8601 or Unix seconds.

all_day.description: Whether the event is all day.

present_share_sheet.description: Present the system share sheet for file_export.

photo_save.summary: Save a workspace image or video file into the user's Photos library.

calendar_create.summary: Create a Calendar event through EventKit after Calendar authorization is available.

file_export.summary: Present the iOS share/export sheet for a workspace file.

open_url.summary: Open an http(s) URL, universal link, or installed-app deep link through the shared native URL executor.

open_settings.summary: Open PythonIDE's page in the iOS Settings app through the shared native URL executor.

clipboard_write.summary: Write user-requested text to the general pasteboard through the same native bridge used by the Python clipboard module.

notification_schedule.summary: Request notification authorization when needed and schedule a local notification without changing the app icon badge.

native_notifications.description: Complete local-notification lifecycle with stable identifiers, recurrence, Agent deep links, and read-back verification, without app icon badges.

request_permission.description: Ask iOS for undetermined permission and await the result.

notification_list.summary: List pending local notifications with their next trigger times and recurrence.

notification_get.summary: Read one pending or delivered local notification by stable identifier.

notification_update.summary: Replace one notification in place while preserving its stable identifier and Agent deep link.

notification_cancel.summary: Cancel one pending notification and remove its delivered copy.

notification_cancel_all.summary: Cancel only Agent-created notifications, leaving unrelated app notifications intact.

notification_verify.summary: Read back a scheduled notification and verify its identifier and next trigger.

native_events.description: Calendar, Reminders, and system Alarm lifecycle backed by EventKit and AlarmKit.

idempotency_key.description: Stable caller key that makes retries return the same verified Agent-owned alarm. Reusing the key with different alarm details fails instead of creating a duplicate.

due.description: ISO-8601 or Unix reminder due date.

calendar_id.description: Target Calendar or Reminders list identifier.

request_permission.description: Ask iOS for undetermined permission and await the result.

calendar_list.summary: List calendars and whether each one can be modified.

calendar_event_get.summary: Read one Calendar event, recurrence, attendees, time zone, and writable state.

calendar_event_update.summary: Modify one Calendar event and verify the saved values by reading it back.

calendar_event_delete.summary: Delete one Calendar event using the requested recurrence span and verify absence.

calendar_conflicts.summary: Find events that overlap a proposed time range.

reminder_get.summary: Read one EventKit reminder and its list, due date, priority, and completion state.

reminder_create.summary: Create a system Reminders item and verify it by identifier.

reminder_update.summary: Modify a system Reminders item and verify the saved values.

reminder_complete.summary: Mark one system reminder complete or incomplete and verify its state.

reminder_delete.summary: Delete one system reminder and verify absence.

alarm_list.summary: List only alarms created through the Agent-owned AlarmKit ledger.

alarm_schedule.summary: Request AlarmKit authorization when needed, idempotently schedule an Agent-owned system alarm, persist ownership, and verify its exact schedule in AlarmManager.

alarm_cancel.summary: Stop an active Agent-owned AlarmKit alarm when needed, cancel its remaining schedule, and verify complete removal.

native_files.description: System Files pickers, security-scoped imports/exports, multi-item sharing, and document scanning.

path.description: Workspace-relative source path or destination path.

allowed_types.description: UTType identifiers or filename extensions accepted by a picker.

filename.description: Suggested output or scanned PDF filename.

as_pdf.description: Combine scanned pages into a PDF.

file_pick.summary: Present the system Files picker, await the user's selection, and return security-scoped file metadata.

folder_pick.summary: Present the system folder picker, await selection, and persist a security-scoped bookmark.

file_import.summary: Pick an external file and copy it into the active workspace with collision-safe naming and verification.

file_save.summary: Export a workspace file to a user-selected Files location and await completion.

share_items.summary: Present one system share sheet for text, URL, image, or multiple workspace files.

document_scan.summary: Present the VisionKit document scanner, await completion, and save verified images or a PDF under a collision-safe workspace filename.

native_media.description: User-selected photos and camera capture plus deterministic on-device Vision analysis.

path.description: Workspace-relative image input or output path.

filename.description: Suggested workspace filename for selected or captured media.

text.description: Text or URL to encode as QR.

request_permission.description: Ask iOS for undetermined permission and await the result.

photo_pick.summary: Present the privacy-preserving Photos picker, await selection, and copy chosen media into the workspace.

photo_capture.summary: Request camera access when needed, present capture UI, and save the captured image into the workspace.

photo_metadata.summary: Read dimensions, orientation, color model, file size, and image metadata from a workspace image.

vision_ocr.summary: Run Apple Vision text recognition on a workspace image and return text with confidence and bounding boxes.

vision_barcodes.summary: Detect QR codes and supported barcodes in a workspace image using Apple Vision.

vision_classify.summary: Classify a workspace image on device using Apple Vision.

vision_rectangles.summary: Detect document-like rectangles in a workspace image.

qr_generate.summary: Generate a QR image from model-provided content and save it into the workspace.

native_audio.description: Text-to-speech, live/file speech recognition, and lifecycle-safe microphone recording.

path.description: Workspace-relative audio input or recording output path.

request_permission.description: Ask iOS for undetermined speech/microphone permission and await the result.

speech_speak.summary: Speak model-provided text with the system synthesizer and optionally await completion.

speech_recognition_start.summary: Request speech and microphone permissions, then start live transcription.

speech_recognition_stop.summary: Stop live transcription and return the final captured text.

audio_transcribe.summary: Transcribe a workspace audio file and return the verified final transcript.

audio_record_start.summary: Request microphone permission and start recording to a workspace file.

audio_record_stop.summary: Stop recording and verify the resulting workspace audio file.

audio_record_cancel.summary: Cancel the active recording and remove its partial file.

audio_record_status.summary: Read recording state, duration, level, and output path.

native_people_location.description: Precise, minimally scoped Location and Contacts actions; contact pickers never disclose the whole address book.

geofence_id.description: Stable geofence identifier for get/update/delete semantics.

idempotency_key.description: Stable key which makes repeated geofence creation update the same system region.

title.description: Local notification title for a region event.

body.description: Local notification body for a region event.

query.description: Contact name, email, or phone query.

request_permission.description: Ask iOS for undetermined permission and await the result.

location_geocode.summary: Resolve an address into coordinates with the system geocoder.

location_reverse_geocode.summary: Resolve coordinates into a postal address with the system geocoder.

location_heading.summary: Request Location permission when needed and read one bounded compass-heading sample.

geofence_list.summary: List persistent Agent geofences and their actual Core Location monitoring state.

geofence_create.summary: Request Always Location and notification permission, monitor one circular region, persist it idempotently, and verify registration.

geofence_delete.summary: Stop and delete one persistent geofence, then verify it is absent.

contact_search.summary: Search Contacts by an explicit query and return only bounded matching fields.

contact_create.summary: Create one contact and verify the returned identifier.

contact_update.summary: Update one contact and verify the saved values.

contact_delete.summary: Delete one contact and verify absence.

contact_pick.summary: Present the system contact picker and return only the contact selected by the user.

vcard_export.summary: Export explicitly identified contacts as a workspace vCard.

vcard_import.summary: Import contacts from a workspace vCard and return created identifiers.

native_health_motion.description: Minimally scoped HealthKit reads/writes and bounded Core Motion snapshots.

request_permission.description: Ask iOS for only the exact requested data types and await the result.

health_steps.summary: Request read access only to step count and return an aggregate for the requested interval.

health_heart_rate.summary: Request read access only to heart rate and return bounded samples.

health_sleep.summary: Request read access only to sleep analysis and return bounded intervals.

health_weight.summary: Request read access only to body mass and return bounded samples.

health_workouts.summary: Request read access only to workouts and return bounded records.

health_save_weight.summary: Request write access only to body mass, save one sample, and verify authorization.

motion_snapshot.summary: Collect one short, bounded Core Motion snapshot and stop the sensor immediately.

native_hardware.description: Explicit, bounded Bluetooth LE and NFC operations for user-created hardware Skills.

peripheral_uuid.description: Bluetooth peripheral UUID returned by a scan.

data_base64.description: Base64 bytes for a characteristic write.

bluetooth_state.summary: Read the current Core Bluetooth manager state.

bluetooth_scan.summary: Run a bounded Bluetooth LE scan and return discovered peripheral identifiers.

bluetooth_connect.summary: Connect to one explicitly identified Bluetooth peripheral.

bluetooth_services.summary: Discover services and characteristics on a connected peripheral.

bluetooth_read.summary: Read one explicitly identified Bluetooth characteristic.

bluetooth_write.summary: Write bytes to one explicitly identified Bluetooth characteristic.

nfc_scan.summary: Present the system NFC scan sheet and await an NDEF result.

nfc_write.summary: Present the system NFC writer and write explicit NDEF records.

native_automation.description: Agent Live Activity lifecycle and system-reviewed Mail/SMS compose flows.

activity_id.description: Agent run or Live Activity identifier.

live_activity_status.summary: Read Live Activity support, authorization, and active Agent activity state.

live_activity_start.summary: Start an Agent-linked Live Activity for a long-running task.

live_activity_update.summary: Update the current Agent-linked Live Activity.

live_activity_end.summary: End the current Agent-linked Live Activity.

mail_compose.summary: Present Apple's Mail composer with recipients, content, and workspace attachments; iOS requires the user to review and send.

message_compose.summary: Present Apple's Messages composer with recipients, content, and attachments; iOS requires the user to review and send.

categories.deviceSensors: Device state, sensors, location, feedback, biometrics, and health.
categories.systemServices: Permissions, persistence, secrets, dialogs, notifications, contacts, calendar, live activities, and NFC.
categories.mediaVision: Photos, audio, speech, video, Vision, and Core ML.
categories.networkData: Network, WebSocket, Bluetooth, background tasks, and C extension availability.
categories.automationExtensions: Shortcuts, Objective-C Runtime access, system framework access, and keyboard toolbar integration.

photo_picker.summary: Inline Photos library picker inside AppUI forms.

camera_picker.summary: Inline camera capture control for AppUI screens.

file_importer.summary: UIDocumentPicker bridge for arbitrary files in AppUI.

share_link.summary: System share sheet via AppUI ShareLink.

map_view.summary: MapKit-backed map view for AppUI location workflows.

video_player.summary: Embedded AVPlayer view for AppUI; prefer over avplayer module in MiniApps.

player_controller.summary: Playback controller paired with VideoPlayer in AppUI.

camera.summary: Camera capture via photos.capture_image or AppUI CameraPicker.

file_picker.summary: File selection has no import module; use AppUI FileImporter.

share.summary: System share sheet has no import module; use AppUI ShareLink.

scene.summary: SpriteKit scene runtime for games and animations.
